notes:
- Cats vs Dogs 1.3.5 has a wider board and larger numeric scoreboards. Update the game from Get Games. Online series go to three round wins when both players have the updated app.
- The chat button highlights unread match messages without covering the board.
- The Return to game button is easier to spot during a call, and the turn indicator uses the original Cats vs Dogs coins.
- Incoming calls can still be missed while the recipient’s screen is off.
